body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Liquavista displayed 'Liquavista ColorBright', a range of bright and colorful displays that are suitable for use in secondary mobile phone device, meters, watches, other portable and mobile applications at the 2009 International CES.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
